noncomputable def explicitMackeyTerm1 (s : G) : H1 U M →+ H1 V M :=
  (explicitCor1 V M ((mackeySubgroup s U V).subgroupOf V)
      (U.isOpen_mackeySubgroup_subgroupOf V hU s)).comp
    (explicitMap1 U M ((mackeySubgroup s U V).subgroupOf V) M (U.continuousMackeyToH V s)
      (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom M s) ((continuous_const_smul s).congr fun _ => rfl)
      (smul_continuousMackeyToH_smul G M U V s))

evidence: explicitCor1_mackey needs only a topological group G, U open of finite index, any subgroup V and a topological G-module M with continuous action, and its summand cor^V_{V meet sUs^-1} o (s)_* o res matches [M]'s summand under V=I, U=H; this strictly contains [M]'s case G_K, H=G_L, inertia I, M=T/2^a. Neither the declaration nor its summand is used outside Mackey/Basic.lean.

explicitCor1_mackey has only section variables: a topological group G, a topological G-module M with continuous action, an open subgroup U of finite index, any subgroup V and double-coset representatives r. It concludes res_V cor_U x = sum over V\G/U of cor^V_{V meet sUs^-1} (s)_* res x, which is (K7) with G = G_K, U = H = G_L, V = I and discrete M = T/2^a. The general statement covers more cases, so it is stronger. The note is accurate: outside its own file, only the degree-two Mackey formula is applied (CorestrictionLocalization.lean), and the degree-one formula is used nowhere.
